question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Operating cash flow covers net income. Operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} a year earlier, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} two years earlier (a low-income year), {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in the loss year, and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in the two years before that. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}; on the trend table's year-end-asset basis the ratio is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, third highest of five filled years, after {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} a year earlier, which was the highest. Negative accruals mean cash ran ahead of income, and it did so in a year in which the notes say no receivables were sold, whereas the prior year's operating cash flow had been helped by receivables sold without recourse. Working capital absorbed cash: receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income; inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}; payables supplied {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} on the balance sheet, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}; trade working capital as a whole rose {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital}. Articulation: receivables and inventory articulate exactly, with gaps of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} and {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}; accounts payable does not, the balance-sheet change of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} against a cash-flow line of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change} leaving a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}. MD&A attributes the payables rise to capital expenditures, which would sit outside the operating line and so explain a gap, but the supplier finance obligation recorded within payables rose from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.supplier_finance_obligation} to {terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation}, a rise larger than the entire balance-sheet change in payables, so the composition of payables shifted toward bank-confirmed obligations and the non-programme balance fell. The largest single lift to operating cash flow is the change in accrued expenses, income taxes and warranty, which the release prints as a large positive against a negative a year earlier and which MD&A attributes to accrued income taxes and legal settlements: the tax provision was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} while the notes newly disclose cash taxes paid as a small fraction of it, the rate reconciliation carries a qualified domestic minimum top-up tax line, the balance sheet a non-current income tax payable, and legal settlements are accrued with most of the cash expected within one year. That part of fiscal 2026 operating cash flow is cash that has not yet left; the calculator carries no field for the unpaid amount, so it is described here and not adjusted. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, just under one: quarterly net income moved about as much as quarterly operating cash flow, so there is no sign of income being smoothed against cash. Simple free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.free_cash_flow_simple} a year earlier; after share-based compensation and the adjustment below the quality-adjusted figure is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}. Fiscal 2026 was a fifty-three-week year, which lengthens every flow measure against the prior year.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: cash-backed, but part of the operating cash flow is deferred tax and settlement outflows and a bank-confirmed payables programme, and receivables absorbed a meaningful share of income

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables outran revenue. Year-end days sales outstanding is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, up from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} and second highest of five filled years (the highest was {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} four years back; the lowest {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} two years back); on average balances the figure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. Receivables over revenue rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, so receivables grew faster than revenue, whose trailing growth was {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. MD&A explains the receivables rise as primarily due to increased revenue; a rising ratio says revenue alone does not explain it. The notes supply the missing piece, which the fiscal 2025 explanation had named and the fiscal 2026 one drops: no receivables were sold in fiscal 2026 after sales without recourse in fiscal 2025, so the prior-year base was depressed by factoring. That accounts for part of the rise but cannot be sized from the calculator. Within the year the quarterly series went {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year-ago third quarter, {trend_table.quarters-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in the second quarter and {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in the third; no fourth-quarter cell exists. Receivables are now concentrated in three customers at {concentration.facts.1|pct}, {concentration.facts.2|pct} and {concentration.facts.3|pct} against one customer at {concentration.facts.0|pct} a year earlier, and the company does not generally require collateral. Fourth-quarter revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue} for the year grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year and {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} sequentially, with the release's fourth-quarter gross margin above the annual {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}; the release says results exceeded the company's own expectations and guides the next quarter higher still. Contract liabilities cannot be tested: the calculator finds none of the current or total concepts tagged, and the only tagged concept, the noncurrent contract liability, is reported in the numbers report only to the January quarter, where it was slightly lower than at the prior year end. Revenue policy wording, sales-incentive policy and the critical estimate on sales program accruals are carried unchanged, and the auditor's critical audit matter on sales incentive programs shows no change evident; no new judgment area (variable consideration, principal versus agent, standalone selling price), no extended payment terms and no bill-and-hold wording is reported. The revenue explanation attributes growth to exabytes shipped and favorable pricing actions and does not mention the fifty-third week, which sits in the first quarter.
revenue_recognition.verdict: moderate concern: receivables outran revenue, the explanation is incomplete, and receivables concentration rose; the end of factoring explains part, and no policy or judgment change is found

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Reserves are not thinning where they can be seen. The warranty accrual rose to {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual} and the warranty reserve ratio to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, third highest of five filled years; the numbers report shows the noncurrent portion rising faster than the current portion, and the notes' warranty rollforward carries no prose explanation, so the reason for a longer-tailed reserve is not stated. The bad-debt allowance has no fiscal 2026 value in the record; the last filled year printed {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} on an allowance of {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance}, second lowest of four filled years, so whether the allowance kept pace with receivables that rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} and became more concentrated cannot be tested. No inventory valuation reserve is tagged in any period. Goodwill: the policy is carried and no impairment, headroom, discount-rate or growth-assumption disclosure is reported. Tax: the effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} on a provision of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} against pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income}, a step up from the prior year that the notes attribute to the Pillar Two minimum tax now in effect. Inside that rate sit items that raise income: a discrete benefit from releasing valuation allowances in connection with the OBBBA, net excess tax benefits from share-based compensation, and the Singapore and Thailand incentive benefit, now stated net of the top-up tax. The valuation allowance fell in the year, mainly from those releases, with an internal reorganization whose tax attributes were fully offset by valuation allowance and which is not otherwise described. Unrecognized tax benefits rose, with the whole gross increase from current-year positions and no prior-year decreases. The critical estimates are listed as sales program accruals and income taxes, with warranty, inventory and goodwill named non-critical; whether warranty was dropped from the list is not determinable from the input. A net gain on the sale of a strategic investment and the release of legal-settlement uncertainty in the other direction (a charge) are the other estimate-driven items. None of the release amounts is a calculator field, so no earnings adjustment can be carried for them.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: mixed: warranty reserve thickened and tax positions grew, a valuation-allowance release and excess tax benefits lifted income inside a rising rate, and the allowance and inventory reserve cannot be observed

cost_deferral.finding: No capitalisation signal is found. Research and development is expensed at {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}, up on the prior year, and no capitalized software development concept is tagged in any period, so no capitalized-to-expensed comparison exists. The soft-asset share fell to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the highest of five years a year ago to the second lowest now, as cash and property, plant and equipment grew; property, plant and equipment is {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment} on capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure}. Three things do bear on reported cost. First, operating government grants were credited against cost of revenue, product development and marketing and administrative expense, capital grants reduced gross property, and grant receivables sit in other current and other assets; the grants are conditional and can be reduced, recaptured or terminated, and the gross-margin explanation, which credits pricing actions and mix for a margin of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, does not name them. Second, items the release labels as outside normal or ongoing performance recur: restructuring charges were recorded in both fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025, and losses on debt transactions were recorded in each of the last three years, with a further loss announced for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, all excluded from non-GAAP results. Third, the non-GAAP to GAAP gap cannot be computed here because the record holds no non-GAAP concept; the release prints GAAP and non-GAAP net income side by side for both years, and the exclusions (share-based compensation, debt-transaction losses, restructuring, the legal settlement, intangible amortization, and a strategic investment gain in the other direction) are all named. Inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}, primarily work in process per MD&A, while days sales of inventory eased to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}.
cost_deferral.verdict: no capitalisation or soft-asset signal; grants offset costs without being named in the margin explanation, and items labelled non-recurring recur

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Factoring: the notes say no receivables were sold in fiscal 2026 after sales without recourse in fiscal 2025, and the calculator's proceeds-from-sale-of-receivables field is absent for this period though the concept exists in the record, which is consistent; the cessation is one reason receivables and days sales outstanding rose. Supplier finance: the confirmed obligation, recorded within accounts payable, rose from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.supplier_finance_obligation} to {terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation}, more than the entire balance-sheet rise in payables of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}; MD&A attributes the payables rise to capital expenditures and does not mention the programme. Days payables outstanding are {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding}, giving a cash conversion cycle of {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle}. Payables carried under a bank programme are financing in substance, so the year-end balance is carried below as a reduction to cash flow. Classification: the payables articulation gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap} is consistent with capital-expenditure payables excluded from the operating line; no shifting between operating and investing is otherwise found. Deferred outflows inside operating cash flow: accrued income taxes (a top-up tax line and a non-current income tax payable, against cash taxes paid that are a small fraction of the provision of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense}) and accrued legal settlements with most of the cash due within one year; no calculator field carries the unpaid amount, so it is not adjusted. Purchase obligations: unrecorded unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, and the note adds long-term market-share-based inventory purchase commitments with no amount, which MD&A calls non-cancellable; MD&A states a much larger total with most due within one year and equipment commitments mostly due within a year, alongside guidance that capital expenditure will rise for the HAMR ramp. Leases: the operating lease liability fell to {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability}. Guarantees: no maximum-exposure concept is tagged; guarantee and indemnification wording is carried. No variable-interest entity is reported. Debt: repayments were {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}, debt fell to {terms.debt_now} from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier}, and part of the exchangeable-note retirement was settled in ordinary shares with a non-cash induced conversion expense, which with net income turned equity from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.stockholders_equity} to {terms.balances_now.stockholders_equity}; remaining exchange excess will be delivered in shares. Share-based compensation was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation}, a real cost excluded from the release's non-GAAP earnings and guidance; it is already subtracted in the quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: adverse on one point: the supplier finance obligation multiplied within payables and is not named in the payables explanation; purchase commitments rose sharply; factoring ceased and no classification shifting is found

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Clean on the formal signals. The auditor's opinion and the internal-control opinion are unqualified with dates rolled forward, tenure is carried, the single critical audit matter (sales incentive programs) is on the same subject as the critical estimate and shows no change evident, disclosure controls and internal control are stated effective, and no change in internal control is reported. No material weakness, no auditor change, no late-filing notice and no amendment appear. The numbers reader found no superseded fact whose earlier value differs, so there is no quiet restatement. Three officer-or-director-change filings on Form 8-K were made during the year, but their bodies are not in the input, so whether the chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller changed is unresolved; the chief financial officer is still named in the year-end insider-trading-plan disclosure, where he adopted a prearranged selling plan running to the end of calendar 2026. Two internal inconsistencies within the 10-K are noted: MD&A says the long-term principal will mature in more than one year while the balance sheet carries a current portion of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current} against none a year earlier and a large redemption was completed after year end; and the share-repurchase count is stated one way in the notes and another in MD&A, though the cash amount of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} agrees with the statement. Two accounting-standard adoptions in the year matter for presentation: the induced-conversion standard, adopted prospectively ahead of its mandatory date and applied to the note exchanges, routes the exchange cost through net loss from debt transactions, a line excluded from non-GAAP results; and the tax-disclosure standard, which newly reveals cash taxes paid. Related parties: nothing found. Subsidiary list: the exhibit diff is not in the input. SEC comment letters: none reported. Naming inconsistencies in the equity-plan paragraphs are minor.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: clean opinions and controls; unread officer-change filings and two internal inconsistencies leave small open points

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K earnings release and the 10-K agree on every headline figure the calculator can derive: fourth-quarter revenue {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, fourth-quarter net income {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, fourth-quarter operating cash flow {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, fiscal-year net income {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}, operating cash flow {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}, the tax provision {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense}, prior-year operating cash flow {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.operating_cash_flow}, and the release's free cash flow, which equals the calculator's {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} for this year and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.free_cash_flow_simple} for last. Two placement differences remain: the 10-K says intangible amortization is charged to operating expenses while the release adds it back in reaching non-GAAP gross profit, and the release's reconciliations add back a small net loss from business divestiture in the April quarter that the 10-K's divestiture note does not mention and whose GAAP line is not identified. Of the forty-nine items in the notes report, each is reconciled in the list below: the numbers confirm the debt reduction, the receivables, inventory and payables increases, the revenue and gross-margin rise, the research-and-development rise, the tax-provision rise, the repurchase amount, the loss on debt transactions and the unconditional purchase obligations; they contradict the account-level direction of the discrete-tax-benefit item, the payables explanation as a primary driver, and the receivables explanation as a complete one; forward-looking, subsequent-event and prose-only items are unresolved.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: release and annual report agree on headline figures; two placement differences and three contradicted explanations

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: no inventory valuation reserve is tagged in any period, so reserve adequacy cannot be tested; inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}, the rise being primarily work in process per MD&A, and days sales of inventory eased to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} (third highest of five years), with the third-quarter cell at {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, second lowest of six; inventory is named a non-critical estimate. Purchase commitments in excess of need: unrecorded unconditional purchase obligations rose to {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, mainly inventory components scheduled for fiscal 2028 onward, MD&A states a far larger total mostly due within one year, and market-share-based inventory commitments are described as non-cancellable with no amount given; against demand the company describes as strengthening these look like supply-securing for the HAMR ramp, but if demand turned they would exceed need, and their size cannot be set against the inventory reserve. Customer concentration: on the receivables benchmark, three customers at {concentration.facts.1|pct}, {concentration.facts.2|pct} and {concentration.facts.3|pct} at year end against one at {concentration.facts.0|pct} a year earlier; no revenue-benchmark concentration fact is in the calculator. Channel stuffing: days sales outstanding rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} and fourth-quarter revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} sequentially, which are the shapes channel stuffing would produce, but the end of factoring, the pricing actions, and the noted absence of extended payment terms or bill-and-hold wording leave nothing found beyond the receivables observations above. Circular or vendor-financed deals: nothing found; the strategic investments are carried at a small measurement-alternative value, the year's investment activity was a sale producing a gain, and no investment in a customer that then buys from the company is reported.
industry_lens.verdict: receivables concentration rose and purchase commitments rose sharply; inventory reserve unobservable; no channel-stuffing or vendor-financing signal found

anomalies.name_ko: 발생액 비율이 최고치에서 음수로 전환
anomalies.what: Operating cash flow over net income moved to {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, and accruals over year-end assets to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, the highest of five years. Cash now runs ahead of income, in a year without the factoring that helped the prior year. Benign in direction, but a sharp break from the company's own past.

anomalies.name: Operating cash flow lifted by accrued but unpaid taxes and settlements
anomalies.name_ko: 미지급 세금과 합의금 누적이 영업현금흐름을 끌어올림
anomalies.what: The accrued expenses, income taxes and warranty line turned from a use of cash to a large source, which MD&A attributes to accrued income taxes and legal settlements. The provision of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} compares with newly disclosed cash taxes paid that are a small fraction of it, a top-up tax line in the rate reconciliation and a non-current income tax payable on the balance sheet; legal settlements are accrued with most of the cash due within one year. The cash will leave in later periods. No calculator field carries the unpaid amount, so no adjustment is made.

anomalies.name: Payables do not articulate between balance sheet and cash-flow statement
anomalies.name_ko: 매입채무의 재무상태표 변동과 현금흐름표 변동 불일치
anomalies.what: Balance-sheet payables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} while the cash-flow line shows {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}. MD&A attributes the rise to capital expenditures, which would be excluded from the operating line and so explain a gap, but the amount so excluded is not stated. Receivables and inventory articulate exactly.

anomalies.name: Receivables absorb a meaningful share of net income
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 증가가 순이익의 상당 부분을 흡수
anomalies.what: Receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, which is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income, and trade working capital as a whole rose {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital}. Operating cash flow still exceeded net income because of the accrued-liability lift described above.

anomalies.name: Days sales outstanding rise explained by revenue alone
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권회전일수 상승을 매출 증가만으로 설명
anomalies.what: Days sales outstanding rose to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, second highest of five years, and receivables over revenue to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}. MD&A says the increase is primarily due to increased revenue; a rising ratio contradicts that as a complete explanation. The prior-year explanation cited lower factoring; this year's drops it although the notes say no receivables were sold in fiscal 2026, which is the omitted driver.

anomalies.name: Extra week omitted from the revenue and margin explanations
anomalies.name_ko: 추가 한 주가 매출·마진 설명에서 누락
anomalies.what: Fiscal 2026 had one more week than fiscal 2025, the extra week sitting in the first quarter. The revenue explanation credits exabytes shipped and pricing actions and the margin explanation pricing and mix; neither mentions the week. Revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} therefore includes a calendar effect the numbers cannot size, and the next first-quarter comparison will be against a fourteen-week base.

anomalies.name: Fourth-quarter step-up in revenue and margin
anomalies.name_ko: 넷째 분기 매출과 마진의 급격한 상승
anomalies.what: Fourth-quarter revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year and {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} sequentially, and the release's fourth-quarter gross margin sits above the annual {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} and above the third quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, itself the highest of six quarters. Fourth-quarter net income was {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} against operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, so the quarter's earnings were cash-backed. The release calls it above the company's own expectations.

anomalies.name: Contract liabilities not observable at year end
anomalies.name_ko: 연말 계약부채를 확인할 수 없음
anomalies.what: None of the current or total contract-liability concepts is tagged in any period; only the noncurrent concept is, and the numbers report has it only to the January quarter, slightly below the prior year end. Whether deferred revenue moved against revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue} cannot be tested.

anomalies.name: Valuation-allowance release and excess tax benefits raise income
anomalies.name_ko: 이연법인세 평가충당금 환입과 초과세제혜택이 이익을 높임
anomalies.what: The provision includes a discrete benefit from releasing valuation allowances in connection with the OBBBA and net excess tax benefits from share-based compensation; the valuation allowance fell in the year, and an internal reorganization not otherwise described also changed tax attributes. These raise net income inside an effective rate of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}. The release amount is not a calculator field, so no earnings adjustment can be carried.

anomalies.name: Unrecognized tax benefits rise on current-year positions
anomalies.name_ko: 당기 세무포지션으로 미인식 세무혜택 증가
anomalies.what: Unrecognized tax benefits rose, the whole gross increase from current-year positions with no prior-year decreases, in the year the Pillar Two minimum tax took effect. Larger uncertain positions mean the provision of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} rests more on judgment. No calculator field carries the balance.

anomalies.name: Warranty accrual rises, mostly noncurrent, with no explanation
anomalies.name_ko: 보증충당부채가 설명 없이 비유동 중심으로 증가
anomalies.what: The warranty accrual rose to {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual} and the ratio to revenue to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}; the numbers report shows the noncurrent portion growing faster than the current. The rollforward carries no prose. A thicker reserve is conservative for earnings, but a longer tail suggests longer warranty terms or higher expected claims on the new product mix, and warranty is now listed as a non-critical estimate.

anomalies.name: Bad-debt allowance and inventory reserve unobservable
anomalies.name_ko: 대손충당금과 재고평가충당금을 확인할 수 없음
anomalies.what: No fiscal 2026 allowance value is in the record, so the ratio cannot be compared with last year's {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}, itself second lowest of four years, in a year when receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} and became concentrated in three customers. No inventory valuation reserve is tagged in any period.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate steps up, but the top-up tax is accrued not paid
anomalies.name_ko: 유효세율은 상승했으나 추가세는 미지급 상태
anomalies.what: The effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} on a provision of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense}, a step up the notes attribute to the Pillar Two minimum tax. The top-up tax sits in the rate reconciliation and a non-current income tax payable while cash taxes paid were a small fraction of the provision, so the earnings cost is recognised but the cash cost is deferred, which flatters operating cash flow this year.

anomalies.name: Government grants credited against costs, omitted from margin explanation
anomalies.name_ko: 정부보조금이 원가에서 차감되었으나 마진 설명에서 누락
anomalies.what: Operating grants were credited against cost of revenue, product development and marketing and administrative expense, capital grants reduced gross property, and grant receivables sit in other current and other assets. The grants are conditional and can be reduced, recaptured or terminated. The margin explanation, for a gross margin of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, credits pricing and mix only. The grant amounts are not calculator fields, so their share of the margin gain cannot be sized.

anomalies.name: Items excluded as non-recurring recur
anomalies.name_ko: 비경상 항목으로 제외된 비용이 반복 발생
anomalies.what: Restructuring charges were recorded in fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025, and the release excludes them as not reflecting normal or ongoing performance. Losses on debt transactions were recorded in each of the last three years, far larger this year, and a further loss is announced for the first quarter of fiscal 2027; the release excludes them from non-GAAP results and guidance. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} is also excluded. The recurrence contradicts the non-recurring label; the non-GAAP to GAAP gap itself is not computable from the record.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP gap not computable from the record
anomalies.name_ko: 비GAAP 이익 격차를 기록에서 계산할 수 없음
anomalies.what: The release prints GAAP and non-GAAP net income side by side for both years, but the record holds no non-GAAP concept and no calculator field carries the gap, so whether it widened cannot be stated here. GAAP net income is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.net_income}.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share falls to second lowest of five years
anomalies.name_ko: 소프트자산 비중이 다섯 개 연도 중 두 번째로 낮은 수준으로 하락
anomalies.what: The soft-asset share fell to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share}, which had been the highest of five years, as cash and property grew on capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure}. Benign: no build-up of capitalized or intangible assets.

anomalies.name: Supplier finance obligation multiplies within payables
anomalies.name_ko: 공급업체 금융 프로그램 채무가 매입채무 안에서 급증
anomalies.what: The confirmed obligation under the supplier finance programme rose from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.supplier_finance_obligation} to {terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation} and is recorded within accounts payable, whose whole balance-sheet rise was {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}. MD&A attributes the payables rise to capital expenditures and does not mention the programme. Bank-confirmed payables are financing in substance and preserve operating cash flow; the year-end balance is carried as a reducing adjustment to free cash flow.

anomalies.name: Receivables factoring ceased
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 매각(팩토링) 중단
anomalies.what: The notes say no receivables were sold in fiscal 2026 after sales without recourse in fiscal 2025. The calculator's proceeds-from-sale-of-receivables concept exists in the record but is absent for this period, consistent with the prose. This differs from the company's own past and is one reason receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}; it also means this year's operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow} carries no factoring lift, unlike last year's {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.operating_cash_flow}.

anomalies.name: Unconditional purchase obligations rise sharply
anomalies.name_ko: 무조건 구매의무가 급격히 증가
anomalies.what: Unrecorded unconditional purchase obligations rose to {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, mainly inventory components for fiscal 2028 onward; MD&A states a far larger total with most due within one year, plus equipment commitments mostly due within a year and non-cancellable market-share-based inventory commitments with no amount. The operating lease liability fell to {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability}. No guarantee maximum is tagged and no variable-interest entity is reported.

anomalies.name: Debt retired partly in shares with a non-cash induced conversion expense
anomalies.name_ko: 부채를 주식으로 일부 상환하며 비현금 유도전환비용 인식
anomalies.what: Debt fell to {terms.debt_now} from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} on repayments of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}, with the exchangeable-note exchanges settled in cash plus ordinary shares and a non-cash induced conversion expense recorded under a standard adopted ahead of its mandatory date; the offset in paid-in capital and net income moved equity from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.stockholders_equity} to {terms.balances_now.stockholders_equity}. Remaining exchange excess will be delivered in shares, so dilution continues beyond diluted shares of {terms.diluted_shares}. The expense is excluded from non-GAAP results.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rises and is excluded from non-GAAP earnings
anomalies.name_ko: 주식보상비용이 증가했으며 비GAAP 이익에서 제외됨
anomalies.what: Share-based compensation was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation}, under a newly amended equity plan with a larger reserve. It is a real cost that leaves no cash; the release excludes it from non-GAAP earnings and guidance. It is already subtracted in the quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}.

anomalies.name: Officer-change filings not in the input
anomalies.name_ko: 임원 변동 공시의 본문이 입력에 없음
anomalies.what: Three Form 8-K officer-or-director-change filings were made in the year but their bodies are not in the input, so whether the chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller changed is unresolved. The chief financial officer is still named at year end.

anomalies.name: MD&A maturity sentence contradicts the current portion of debt
anomalies.name_ko: MD&A의 만기 서술이 유동성 부채와 모순
anomalies.what: MD&A says the long-term principal will mature in more than one year, yet the balance sheet carries a current portion of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current} against none a year earlier, the debt note classifies the called exchangeable notes as current, and a large senior-note redemption was completed after year end with a loss announced for the first quarter of fiscal 2027.

anomalies.name: Share repurchase count stated two ways
anomalies.name_ko: 자사주 매입 주식 수가 두 가지로 기재됨
anomalies.what: The notes state one share count for fiscal 2026 repurchases and MD&A a larger one that includes shares withheld for taxes; the cash amount of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} agrees with the cash-flow statement. A minor internal inconsistency in the 10-K.

anomalies.name: Induced-conversion standard adopted ahead of its mandatory date
anomalies.name_ko: 유도전환 회계기준을 의무 적용일보다 앞서 채택
anomalies.what: The standard, effective for fiscal years beginning after the December date the note states, was adopted prospectively in fiscal 2026 and applied to the note exchanges, routing the exchange cost through net loss from debt transactions, a line excluded from non-GAAP results. The loss on debt extinguishment tagged for the year is far above either prior year.

anomalies.name: Chief financial officer adopts a prearranged selling plan
anomalies.name_ko: 최고재무책임자가 사전 매도 계획을 채택
anomalies.what: The chief financial officer adopted a prearranged trading plan in the fourth quarter running to the end of calendar 2026, while a director's plan adopted in the third quarter was terminated. Not a departure, and no number bears on it.

anomalies.name: Intangible amortization placed in operating expenses by the 10-K, in cost of revenue by the release
anomalies.name_ko: 무형자산 상각을 10-K는 영업비용에, 실적발표는 매출원가에 배치
anomalies.what: The 10-K note says amortization is charged to operating expenses; the release adds acquired-intangible amortization back in reaching non-GAAP gross profit and not among operating-expense adjustments. The two documents place the same charge differently; the amount is small and not a calculator field.

anomalies.name: Divestiture loss appears only in the release's reconciliation
anomalies.name_ko: 사업매각 손실이 실적발표 조정표에만 등장
anomalies.what: The release's non-GAAP reconciliations add back a small net loss from business divestiture in the April quarter; the 10-K divestiture note mentions no fiscal 2026 gain or loss and the GAAP line is not identified.

anomalies.name: Release headline figures match the annual report
anomalies.name_ko: 실적발표의 주요 수치가 연차보고서와 일치
anomalies.what: Fourth-quarter revenue {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, net income {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} and operating cash flow {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, fiscal-year net income {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}, operating cash flow {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}, the provision {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} and free cash flow {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} all equal the figures the release prints. Clean.

anomalies.name: Receivables concentration rises to three named customers
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 집중도가 세 고객으로 확대
anomalies.what: Three customers hold {concentration.facts.1|pct}, {concentration.facts.2|pct} and {concentration.facts.3|pct} of receivables against one at {concentration.facts.0|pct} a year earlier, while receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} and the company does not generally require collateral. No fiscal 2026 allowance is in the record to test against it.

anomalies.name: Inventory rises on work in process while days of inventory ease
anomalies.name_ko: 재공품 중심으로 재고가 늘었으나 재고회전일수는 소폭 개선
anomalies.what: Inventory rose to {terms.balances_now.inventory} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}, primarily work in process per MD&A, a different composition from the prior year's purchased materials and finished goods. Days sales of inventory eased to {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} on the year and the third-quarter cell of {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} was second lowest of six, so no build relative to cost; no reserve is tagged to test obsolescence.

anomalies.name: Market-share-based purchase commitments carry no amount
anomalies.name_ko: 시장점유율 연동 구매약정의 금액이 공시되지 않음
anomalies.what: Beyond unrecorded unconditional purchase obligations of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, the note adds long-term market-share-based inventory purchase commitments with no amount, which MD&A calls non-cancellable. Whether these exceed need cannot be tested; against inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} and demand the company describes as strengthening they read as supply-securing, but the exposure if demand turned is unquantified.

adjustments.name: supplier finance programme obligation carried within accounts payable
adjustments.quote: The supplier finance table (notes:91) states confirmed obligations outstanding of $400 million at the end of fiscal 2026 and $20 million at the beginning, and notes:89 says these are recorded within Accounts payable. The MD&A explanation does not mention the program.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 영업현금흐름 대 순이익 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}로 전년의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}에서 크게 개선되었고 발생액 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}로 음수이며, 순이익과 현금흐름의 분기 변동성 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}로 이익 평탄화 징후는 없습니다. 다만 매출채권 증가가 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct}를 흡수했고, 매입채무의 재무상태표 변동과 현금흐름표 변동 사이에 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}의 차이가 있으며, 아직 지급되지 않은 세금과 소송 합의금 누적이 영업현금흐름을 끌어올렸습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 매출채권회전일수가 {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일에서 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 늘어 다섯 개 연도 중 두 번째로 높고, 매출 대비 매출채권 비율도 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}로 상승해 매출채권이 매출보다 빠르게 늘었습니다. 회사는 매출 증가만을 이유로 들지만 팩토링 중단이 누락된 원인이며, 매출채권이 세 고객({concentration.facts.1|pct}, {concentration.facts.2|pct}, {concentration.facts.3|pct})에 집중되었고 계약부채는 기록에서 확인할 수 없습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 보증충당부채 비율은 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}로 전년 {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}보다 두터워졌고 대손충당금과 재고평가충당금은 기록에 없어 확인할 수 없습니다. 유효세율은 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}로 상승했지만 그 안에는 이연법인세 평가충당금 환입과 주식보상 초과세제혜택 등 이익을 높이는 항목이 들어 있고, 미인식 세무혜택도 늘었습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용 처리되고 자본화된 개발비는 없으며, 소프트자산 비중은 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}로 낮아져 비용 이연 징후는 없습니다. 다만 정부보조금이 원가에서 차감되었는데도 매출총이익률 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}의 설명에서 언급되지 않았고, 비경상 항목으로 제외된 구조조정비와 부채거래손실이 매년 반복됩니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 공급업체 금융 프로그램 채무가 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.supplier_finance_obligation}에서 {terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation}로 급증해 매입채무 전체 증가액 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}를 넘어섰는데도 경영진 설명에는 빠져 있어, 이 잔액을 현금흐름 차감 조정으로 반영했습니다. 매출채권 매각은 중단되었고, 무조건 구매의무는 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}에서 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}로 늘었으며, 주식보상비용 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}는 이미 차감되어 품질조정 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}입니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사의견과 내부통제 의견은 모두 적정이고 중요한 취약점, 감사인 교체, 지연 공시, 재작성은 없습니다. 다만 임원 변동 공시 세 건의 본문이 입력에 없어 확인되지 않았고, 유동성 부채 {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current}가 있는데도 MD&A는 원금이 일 년 넘어 만기라고 서술하는 등 문서 내 불일치가 있습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 실적발표의 넷째 분기 매출 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, 순이익 {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, 연간 영업현금흐름 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}, 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}는 10-K와 일치합니다. 무형자산 상각의 배치와 사업매각 손실의 표시가 두 문서에서 다르며, 주석 항목 마흔아홉 건 가운데 세금 할인혜택 방향, 매출채권 설명, 매입채무 설명 세 건은 숫자와 모순됩니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고는 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}에서 {terms.balances_now.inventory}로 재공품 중심으로 늘었지만 재고회전일수는 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 소폭 개선되었고, 재고평가충당금은 기록에 없어 진부화를 검증할 수 없습니다. 매출채권이 세 고객에 집중되었고 시장점유율 연동 구매약정은 금액이 없으며, 채널 밀어내기나 고객에 대한 투자와 연계된 순환 거래의 징후는 발견되지 않았습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
